_comment: Academic and Scientific aggregators registry, based on recent experimental parsing tests. Outlines the specific anti-bot countermeasures detected and the required parsing methods.

domains.notes: Tolerates automated HTTP/httpx requests well if constrained to ~4s delay between requests. Uses standard HTML structure perfectly parseable by Trafilatura.
Extremely open and friendly. Trafilatura extracts preprint titles, authors, and abstracts perfectly from HTML. JSON/XML API is also available.

Raw HTTP via httpx gets 403. curl_cffi gets 200 but freezes on Cloudflare 'browser check' JS challenge. Web scraping strictly requires a JS-capable headless browser (camoufox/patchright). Alternatively, use official E-utilities API.

SPA/React heavy site. Simple HTTP fetch only yields a skeleton loading screen. Using camoufox (waiting for 'networkidle') successfully executes React, populates DOM, and allows Trafilatura to extract the paper titles and abstracts. Official API throws 429 without a key.
Protected by 'Anubis' JS Proof-of-Work challenge, but may selectively disable it for 'friendly' looking traffic with good delays. httpx can work. Fallback to camoufox if challenged.

Web UI is a heavy SPA and Trafilatura fails to extract content even with camoufox. However, the REST API is extremely friendly and high-quality, returning ~1MB of rich JSON instantly without auth. Strictly prefer API.
Web search page is mostly structural and Trafilatura fails to extract results. The REST API, however, is fully open and free, yielding excellent JSON responses. Strictly prefer API.
DOI lookup only — not a text search API. Pass an explicit DOI. Also requires a valid email param. Skip for general text queries.

230M+ open access papers. REST API v3 is free (no key required for basic use, API key unlocks higher limits). Returns structured JSON with title, authors, abstract, full-text URL, and direct PDF download links. Strictly prefer API over web UI.

Europe PMC REST API is fully open and returns structured JSON with title, authors, abstract, and full-text availability flag. The `resultType=core` parameter includes MeSH terms, citations, and grant info. Biomedical focus but covers all life sciences. Prefer API, web UI is SPA.
Directory of Open Access Journals. REST API returns article-level metadata with direct full-text links. Good for finding peer-reviewed OA content across disciplines. No authentication required.
